acceptance_criteria: Create scripts/retry-demo.sh — an idempotent shell script
Running `bash scripts/retry-demo.sh` twice in a row must succeed both times AND print 'idempotent' the second time
Running with `--fail` flag must exit with code 42 AND write exactly 'retry-demo: intentional failure' to stderr (no other stderr text)
Add tests/retry-demo.test.js that (a) runs the script without args and asserts exit 0, (b) runs it twice and asserts second run prints 'idempotent', (c) runs with --fail and asserts exit code === 42
